name: Panang curry with beef
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai panang curry with beef (4 bowls: 1 1/4 cups coconut milk, 2 tbsp panang paste, 1 tbsp roasted peanuts, 1 1/2 cups sliced beef, 1/2 cup water, 1 tsp each of fish sauce and sugar): per bowl 110 g of coconut milk, 70 g of cooked beef; panang is thick, with little water. Kaffir lime leaves left out.
